root_cause.trajectory_summary: The agent built a D3 v6 single-page dashboard per spec. It explored /root/data (turns 1–4), confirmed 50 stocks across 5 sectors including 10 ETFs with empty marketCap, then created the output tree, copied the CSV data, and downloaded d3.v6.min.js (turn 5). It authored index.html (turn 6), style.css with flex layout and selection styling (turn 7), and visualization.js implementing scaleSqrt sizing, uniform ETF radius, sector-clustered forceX/Y around chart center, forceCollide, ticker labels, legend, tooltip suppressed for ETFs, formatted market cap column, and bidirectional bubble↔row highlight (turn 8). File presence was verified (turn 9), a local http.server confirmed 200s for all endpoints (turns 10–11). Turns 12–21 performed a jsdom render check: after resolving ESM/fetch issues (installing jsdom@22 and shimming window.fetch), the headless run reported 50 bubbles, 50 labels, 50 table rows, 5 legend items, 5 unique fill colors, a valid force-simulated transform (translate 285,177) and radius (~43 px) on the first bubble, and no JS errors. Turn 22 cleaned up test artifacts; turn 23 listed the final file tree with all required paths present. Turn 24 delivered the final answer.

what_worked.item: All required files exist at the required paths (turn 23 listing shows index.html, css/style.css, js/d3.v6.min.js, js/visualization.js, data/stock-descriptions.csv, and 50 CSVs under data/indiv-stock/).
Local HTTP server returned 200 for every endpoint used by the page (turns 10–11).

Headless jsdom render confirmed 50 circle.bubble, 50 bubble-label texts, 50 table rows, and 5 legend items with 5 unique fill colors (turn 21), matching the spec (bubbles per stock, sector-colored legend).

First bubble had a real force-simulated transform (translate(285.4,177.4)) and a scaled radius (~43 px) consistent with a top market-cap stock — evidence that forceX/Y/collide and scaleSqrt are functioning (turn 21).
Sample table rows show correct formatting: "XOM Exxon Mobil Corporation Energy 358.11B" and ETF row "VTV ... ETF —" — confirming market cap suffix formatting and ETF em-dash handling (turn 21).
No JS errors reported by jsdom after fetch was polyfilled (turn 21).

root_cause.outcome_assessment: Headless render confirms all quantitative acceptance signals (50 bubbles/labels/rows, 5 sector colors and legend items, scaled radii, no JS errors) and every required file is in place, so the app almost certainly satisfies the task.
